SELECT mc.id, mc.customer_id, mc.customer_name, mc.phone_number, mc.postal_code, mc.mail_address, mc.member_id, mc.address FROM mast_customer mc
and mc.farmer_id = #{farmerId}
AND discontinued_flg = '0'
and mc.customer_id like concat('%', #{customerId} , '%')
and REPLACE(convert_from(decrypt_iv(decode(NULLIF(mc.customer_name, ''), 'base64'), , , 'aes-cbc/pad:pkcs'), 'UTF-8'), ' ', '') like CONCAT('%', #{customerName}, '%')
and convert_from( decrypt_iv( decode(NULLIF(mc.phone_number, ''), 'base64'), , , 'aes-cbc/pad:pkcs' ), 'UTF-8' ) like CONCAT('%', #{phoneNumber}, '%')
and convert_from(decrypt_iv(decode(NULLIF(mc.postal_code, ''), 'base64'), , , 'aes-cbc/pad:pkcs'), 'UTF-8') like CONCAT('%', #{postalCode}, '%')
and mc.ken_name = #{kenName}
and mc.city_name like CONCAT('%', #{cityName}, '%')
and mc.member_id like CONCAT('%', #{memberId}, '%')
ORDER BY mc.customer_id

SELECT mc.id, mc.customer_id, mc.customer_name, mc.phone_number, mc.postal_code, mc.address, mc.mail_address, mc.postal_code, mc.member_id, mc.town_name, mc.building_etc, mc.ken_name, mc.city_name FROM mast_customer mc WHERE mc.id = #{id}

SELECT mc.id, mc.customer_id, mc.customer_name, mc,phone_number, mc,postal_code, mc.address, mc. mail_address, mc.member_id, mc.ken_name, mc.city_name, mc.town_name, mc,building_etc FROM mast_customer mc WHERE mc.customer_id = #{customerId} AND mc.farmer_id = #{farmerId} LIMIT 1
